parallel.settings.backup_limit.tooltip: How many earlier copies of each character's data to keep, one made each time it enters a world. Lowering this deletes the oldest copies the next time a character is played.
parallel.settings.backup_timing.enter_wo: Each time a character enters a world.
parallel.settings.backup_timing.game_lau: The first time each character enters a world after starting the game.
parallel.settings.backup_timing.world_sa: Before every save, autosaves included. Gives the most restore points, but fills up the limit fastest.
parallel.settings.characters_enabled.too: When off, every world uses its own player data, as it would in vanilla.
parallel.settings.doll_follows_cursor.to: The paper doll on the character screens turns to look at the cursor.
parallel.settings.doll_shows_armor.toolt: The paper doll wears the character's armor and anything else on its head.
parallel.settings.doll_shows_items.toolt: The paper doll holds equipped items in the character's hands.
parallel.settings.enforce_gamemodes.tool: Characters can only enter worlds of their own gamemode: survival, creative or hardcore.
parallel.settings.leave_wait.tooltip: When leaving a server or quitting the game while playing a character there, how long to wait for the server to send the character's last save before going anyway.
parallel.settings.reveal_usernames.toolt: Operators see the username of players on characters next to the character's name, above their head and in the tab list.
parallel.settings.section.worlds.note: Applies to your singleplayer worlds and LAN games you host.
parallel.settings.sync_interval.tooltip: How often the characters of players who joined from another client are saved and sent back to their game, so a crash or lost connection costs at most this much play. Saves Only sends them when the game saves and when they leave.
